panel.name: eight-session carried-session development panel
panel.session_seed_derivation: little-endian uint64 from the first 8 bytes of SHA256(ascii(draw_seed) || NUL || 'renderer-stream' || NUL || session_id)

score.name: S
score.packet_ratio_error: mean absolute log-ratio error over active rate, L1 rate, L2 rate, and x-axis sign-flip rate

corpus_ablation.comparison: complete original P0 cohort versus four-session-pruned R03; not the rejected all-90 expansion

panel.name: eight-session carried-session development grid
panel.aggregation: user-macro within each cell, then mean across the eight model-seed/smoothing/draw cells

corpus_ablation.interpretation: P0 was slightly higher/worse in aggregate and the two were treated as a practical tie; pruning bought no meaningful gain.

handoff_equivalence.comparison: fixed online rank-16 handoff versus the same fixed model with reference warm replay

limitations: This is a frozen promotion receipt, not a paper-level confidence analysis.
The eight-session panel is a non-protected development panel; it is not a final untouched-user test.
The corpus ablation averages eight model-seed/smoothing/draw cells; the float-to-fixed promotion numbers are one seed-7/W5/draw-7001 cell and must not be compared directly.
The eight one-count differences measure online-handoff equivalence, not float-to-fixed quantization error.
